items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...It's on the back of Isabella. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I Don't Know. I Don't Know. I Don't Know. It's on the back of which one? Isabella.

ctx.x: I Won't Give You None. That's all. I don't know that. It's on the back of Isabella. Sure enough. Yeah, you must have played it, but you don't remember it. I Won't Give You None. I Won't Give You None. I Won't Give You None. I Guess I did.
I Don't Know. I Don't Know.
